title: extract CredentialStore to usenet-ipfs-auth crate
description: reader/src/store/credentials.rs is well-implemented (bcrypt, timing-safe, file-backed). Both JMAP and SMTP submission need the same thing. Move it to a new crates/auth/ crate (usenet-ipfs-auth) so all consumers share one implementation. Include: CredentialStore, from_file(), merge_from_file(), check() (timing-safe bcrypt). Also move and canonicalize the UserCredential config struct. Document once and for all: the password field in all [auth.users] config stanzas is a bcrypt hash, never plaintext — this must be stated clearly in the struct docstring and config examples or operators will store cleartext.
